responsibility: Declares the TyTy lifetime/region value object used by the Rust frontend’s type system and variance analysis. The Region class models the different kinds of Rust regions the typechecker needs to carry through resolved types—unresolved, 'static, early-bound and late-bound parameters, named, anonymous, and erased regions—together with their parameter index and De Bruijn depth, and provides constructors, classification predicates, shifting for binder traversal, and string formatting for diagnostics/debug output.
